descriptor_docs.attack: Stick contact spike at 2.5-12 kHz versus its first ~35 ms. Higher means a crisper hit.
descriptor_docs.body: Lower shimmer at 1-3.7 kHz against the 3.7-7.9 kHz hiss — how much metal is heard rather than pure air.
descriptor_docs.sizzle: Air and sizzle above ~7.7 kHz sustaining past the hit relative to the hit itself. High = open, airy tail; low = dry tick.
descriptor_docs.bright: Top-end sizzle against lower shimmer over the first ~46 ms.
descriptor_docs.decay: Energy-weighted duration in milliseconds across the whole hat — the closed/open axis. Higher means longer sustain.
